story.title: Good Vibes Reel
story.setting: Bright, sunny, playful summer-day look with warm saturated colours and lively camera moves.

subjects.words: a happy golden retriever with its tongue out, sitting on green grass in a park
a wide-eyed tabby cat with its mouth open in surprise, on a grey sofa
a bearded man and a blonde woman taking a smiling selfie on a sunny beach
a woman with dark curly hair in a grey sweater standing in a green park
a calm mountain lake at sunset with pine trees and pink-lit snowy peaks reflected in the water

beats.text: The golden retriever bounces happily, tail wagging, tongue flapping, camera pushes in playfully
Quick zoom in on the tabby cat as its eyes go even wider and its ears perk up in shock
The two friends laugh and lean together for the selfie as waves roll in behind them
The curly-haired woman breaks into a big grin and gives a cheeky wink to the camera
Slow sweeping glide over the sunset mountain lake, light rippling across the water
